hints.hint: Multiply by each integer from 2 up to n.

solution_steps.title: Multiply up
solution_steps.code: for i in range(2, n + 1): result *= i
solution_steps.how_it_runs: Each loop multiplies result by the next integer.

solution_summary: Loop from 2 to n, multiplying into a running product.
solution_final_thought: Starting at 1 makes the empty case (0! and 1!) fall out naturally.

prompt: Write `fizzbuzz(n)` returning a list for 1..n where multiples of 3 are 'Fizz', of 5 are 'Buzz', of both are 'FizzBuzz', else the number.

hints.hint: Check divisibility by 15 first, then 3, then 5.
Use the modulo operator i % 3 == 0 to test multiples.

solution_steps.title: Check 15 first
solution_steps.how_it_runs: 15 is the least common multiple, so test it before 3 and 5.

solution_final_thought: Order the conditions from most specific to least.
